newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P sets AA+ on Venantius dual currency bond.
newsitem.headline: S&P sets AA+ on Venantius dual currency bond.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said it assigned its AA+ foreign currency long-term rating to Venantius AB's Yen 20 billion (about $180 million) 4.85-percent dual currency bond due June 6, 2000.
S&P said the outlook for the sovereign long-term foreign currency rating was negative, while the outlook for the local currency rating is stable.
Venantius' rating reflects the company's strong relationship with the Kingdom of Sweden, it said.
Venantius, which manages and finances housing loans approved by public authorities, is wholly owned by the Kingdom of Sweden and there are no present or future intentions to privatise the company.
S&P said the negative outlook reflected the negative outlook on its parent, the Kingdom of Sweden.
